objective: Permitir que un push de un nuevo job de ChatGPT a worker/requests despierte inmediatamente el Worker del runtime Preview sin ejecutar comandos arbitrarios y sin tocar Produccion. El endpoint solo acepta el SHA del HEAD real de worker/requests, verifica ese SHA contra origin/worker/requests y lanza un script fijo que ejecuta bridge, dispatcher, publisher y health con lock. Agregar workflow de GitHub Actions limitado a worker_queue/inbox/**.

actions.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="${EDARSAHUB_ROOT:-/app}"
DIR="$ROOT/tools/mirror_sync"
STATE="$ROOT/.git/universal-worker-queue"
LOCK="$STATE/trigger-now.lock"
mkdir -p "$STATE"

if [ -x "$ROOT/.venv/bin/python" ]; then
  PYTHON_BIN="$ROOT/.venv/bin/python"
else
  PYTHON_BIN="$(command -v python3 2>/dev/null || command -v python 2>/dev/null || true)"
fi

if [ -z "${PYTHON_BIN:-}" ] || [ ! -x "$PYTHON_BIN" ]; then
  echo "ABORT=WORKER_PYTHON_NOT_EXECUTABLE"
  exit 4
fi

exec 9>"$LOCK"
if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if ! flock -n 9; then
    echo "UNIVERSAL_WORKER_TRIGGER=BUSY"
    exit 0
  fi
fi

"$PYTHON_BIN" "$DIR/universal_job_bridge.py" receive

COUNT=0
while [ "$COUNT" -lt 25 ]; do
  COUNT=$((COUNT + 1))
  OUT="$("$PYTHON_BIN" "$DIR/universal_job_dispatcher.py" 2>&1 || true)"
  printf '%s\n' "$OUT"
  "$PYTHON_BIN" "$DIR/universal_job_result_publisher.py" || true
  if printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'UNIVERSAL_DISPATCHER=NO_PENDING_JOBS'; then
    break
  fi
  if printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'UNIVERSAL_DISPATCHER=BUSY'; then
    break
  fi
done

"$PYTHON_BIN" "$DIR/runtime_health_publisher.py" || true
echo "UNIVERSAL_WORKER_TRIGGER=COMPLETE"

@app.get("/api/health")
async def health_check():
    """
    Endpoint de salud vital. La infraestructura (Docker/Kubernetes) hará ping aquí.
    Si el servidor se bloquea, la infraestructura lo detectará y reiniciará el nodo.
    """
    return {"status": "operativo", "sistema": "EDARSA HUB", "version": "1.0"}


@app.post("/api/internal/worker/wake")
async def wake_universal_worker(request: Request):
    """Despierta el Worker determinista sin aceptar comandos ni payload ejecutable.

    El caller debe enviar X-Worker-Queue-Sha y ese SHA debe ser exactamente el
    HEAD remoto actual de worker/requests. La autorizacion del trabajo real
    permanece dentro de universal_job_bridge.py mediante RBAC SQL canonico.
    """
    import re
    import subprocess

    requested_sha = (request.headers.get("X-Worker-Queue-Sha") or "").strip().lower()
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", requested_sha):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="INVALID_QUEUE_SHA")

    root = Path("/app")
    fetch = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "fetch", "origin", "worker/requests"],
        cwd=str(root),
        text=True,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
        timeout=30,
    )
    if fetch.returncode != 0:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail="QUEUE_FETCH_FAILED")

    head = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "rev-parse", "origin/worker/requests"],
        cwd=str(root),
        text=True,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
        timeout=10,
    )
    if head.returncode != 0:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail="QUEUE_HEAD_UNAVAILABLE")

    actual_sha = head.stdout.strip().lower()
    if actual_sha != requested_sha:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="QUEUE_SHA_MISMATCH")

    trigger = root / "tools" / "mirror_sync" / "trigger_universal_worker_now.sh"
    if not trigger.is_file():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail="WORKER_TRIGGER_NOT_INSTALLED")

    log_dir = root / ".git" / "universal-worker-queue" / "runtime"
    log_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    log_path = log_dir / "wake-trigger.log"
    log_handle = open(log_path, "ab", buffering=0)
    try:
        subprocess.Popen(
            ["bash", str(trigger)],
            cwd=str(root),
            stdout=log_handle,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            start_new_session=True,
        )
    finally:
        log_handle.close()

    return {"accepted": True, "queue_sha": actual_sha, "production_allowed": False}

actions.content:
name: Worker Queue Wake

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - worker/requests
    paths:
      - 'worker_queue/inbox/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: edarsahub-worker-wake
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  wake-preview-worker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 2
    steps:
      - name: Wake deterministic EDARSAHUB worker
        env:
          QUEUE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          WAKE_URL: https://erp-crm-enterprise-1.preview.emergentagent.com/api/internal/worker/wake
        run: |
          curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error \
            --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 \
            --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 \
            -X POST \
            -H "X-Worker-Queue-Sha: ${QUEUE_SHA}" \
            "${WAKE_URL}"
